Imported Italy interval begins in 1878, after 1861 unification and 1870 capture of Rome. Historical date override does not redraw or certify polygons.

The 1861 kingdom, fascist dictatorship and 1946 republic are political phases of a continuing state. Household amenities, migration and schooling varied across region and class; no example claims universality.
The Italian constitutional excerpt is a brief original-language sample; UNESCO records additional historical minority languages. Narrative awaits independent review.

proposedOverrides.summary: The Kingdom of Italy formed in 1861 and took Rome in 1870, before the imported map begins in 1878. Mass emigration and expanding schools marked the kingdom; Fascist dictatorship, colonial war and antisemitic laws brought grave harm. Italy became a republic by referendum in 1946, wrote a new constitution and later established public national health care. Family life changed with industrial migration and household technology, while minority languages continued. Italy remains a republic.
